snippets.description: Rebook entry: requireRole(admin, manager, student); original read; a student must own the lesson; a manager must own the student (managerOwnsStudent); then the status gate rejects only 'live' (400 'A lesson in progress cannot be rebooked'). The ownership checks come first and are unchanged.

Transaction order: lockStudentCredits (per-student advisory lock) -> open-slot lookup (400 if missing) -> getCreditBalance (400 if < 1) -> resolveLessonDefaults(tx, { teacherId, studentId, actorId }) -> insert (enrollmentId, lessonPlanId, planAttachedBy, planAttachedAt, roomCode from the defaults; title/focus from the original) -> slot delete -> one -1 'booking' credit entry tied to the new lesson id -> logActivity lesson.booked.
Unchanged catch: isActiveLessonSlotConflict -> 409 CONFLICT, which rolls back the slot delete and the debit with the insert.

resolveLessonDefaults (not modified): fresh ESL-#### code; the pair's active enrollment row-locked FOR UPDATE; plan = plans[nextPlanIndex + reserved scheduled/live lessons holding plans]; enrollment/plan fields null when there is no active enrollment or the plans run out.
POST /lessons uses the same lock order (lockStudentCredits, balance, resolveLessonDefaults), so rebook adds no new lock ordering.
Local rebookLesson: one added line refuses a live original ('A lesson in progress cannot be rebooked.') after assertCan; enrichment via createLesson and the single changeCredits debit unchanged.

Smoke rebook domain: studentR enrollment in a local variable; scheduled-original rebook (fresh code, next plan, planAttachedBy, enrollment); 0.5-credit refusal; completed and cancelled originals each debit exactly 1 with one lesson.booked; distinct plans across active studentR lessons; live original 400 with the balance unchanged and the slot still open.
